items.description: WARNING: This game contains visual and audio anomalies, disorienting effects, and psychological horror.You wake up in a decaying zone where time loops and reality fractures. The lights flicker. The corridors repeat. Something is deeply wrong—and it's getting worse.Exit Zone is a memory-based anomaly horror game inspired by Exit 8, designed for 1–5 players. Every corridor looks the same—until it doesn’t.How to SurviveObserve your surroundings. Memorize every room, object, sound, and corridor. Advance only when you're certain everything is normal—then pull the green lever. If anything feels off, hit the red lever before it’s too late. Anomalies can be subtle… or dangerous. One wrong choice, and the zone resets—or worse.Gameplay FeaturesAnomaly Observation Mechanics Spot shifting elements in the environment: misplaced objects, altered text, warped visuals, impossible physics, or entities that shouldn’t exist.Solo or Co-op Multiplayer (1–5 Players) Work together to share memory and identify anomalies—or split up and risk it alone.Randomized Runs Each playthrough generates new anomaly patterns, ensuring replayability and paranoia every time.No Combat – Just Observation The only way out is to observe, remember, and choose the correct path.What Makes Exit Zone Different?True psychological tension – no cheap jumpscares.A haunted world designed to sharpen your perception.Anomalies escalate the longer you remain inside.Every decision matters. Every second counts.Do you remember where the door was? Are you sure that corpse wasn’t here before? One wrong choice, and you’ll be part of the zone forever. Welcome to Exit Zone. items.description: Hidden Shelter is a first-person horror game, focused on exploration, developed by the White Vortex studio. It is under development on the Unreal Engine for Windows PC. Explore the area in search of clues and escape from a bloodthirsty being who wants to kill all those who approach the place.The game's story is about three friends who after a sudden white flash on the road got into an accident. Their car crashed. After waking up, Charles and Bernard lose sight of Diego. Diego is Bernard's older brother and friend of Charles who drove the car. Desperate with the strange noise in the woods, Charles decides to go out for help, even though he doesn't believe that Diego was still alive. Bernard, on the other hand, does not want to leave his brother behind and believes that he managed to escape. The two leave for a mansion in the forest in search of their lost friend and at the same time need to stay alive by running away from a sinister creature that inhabits the place.Something unusual happened in that house that resonates around the place as a kind of eternal curse. Bad things happened there. Love has always been blamed for everything.It is up to the player to put the pieces of this dark puzzle together and find out what is the thread that unites the accident, the strange creature, murders and the history of the house itself. items.description: Do what the voice tells you, no matter how wrong it feels.You open your eyes to a bare room. No windows. No doors. No escape. Complete each daily task.Only a bed, a table, a bathroom, and a voice that speaks when you wake. Each morning, it gives you a task. At first, they seem harmless—simple chores in a place that shouldn’t exist. But by the second day, the tone shifts. The tasks grow darker, more personal, more invasive. You begin to wonder what the voice wants from you—or if it wants you to become something else. How far will you go to survive when there’s no way out?The only rule: obey the voice for seven days.
